hpa_cancer_summary: Malignancies exhibited moderate to strong nuclear immunoreactivity. Few prostate, testicular and skin cancers were weakly stained or negative.
Cancers showed moderate to strong nuclear staining. Renal cancers were weakly stained or negative in a few cases.

Breast cancers along with few cases of urothelial cancers displayed moderate to strong nuclear positivity. Moderate cytoplasmic and membranous staining was observed in rare cases of pancreatic cancers. Remaining cancer tissues were weakly stained or negative.
Most cancer cells showed weak to moderate nuclear positivity. A fraction of cells in a few cases of breast and cervical cancers were strongly stained.
Most cancer cells showed distinct nuclear immunoreactivity of varying fraction and intensity. Several lymphomas, testis cancers and liver cancers were negative.

note: no antibody-based tissue IHC in HPA v25.1

hpa_cancer_summary: Brest, ovarian and endometrial cancers displayed strong nuclear positivity. Remaining cancers were negative.

Few cases of melanomas, lung and prostate cancers displayed moderate to strong cytoplasmic staining. Moderate positivity was observed in rare cases of breast cancers. Remaining cancer tissues were weakly stained or negative.
Cases of colorectal, breast, cervical, head and neck cancers and malignant lymphomas showed moderate nuclear positivity. Remaining malignancies were weakly stained or negative.

note: no antibody-based tissue IHC in HPA v25.1

hpa_cancer_summary: Most cancer tissues showed weak to moderate cytoplasmic and/or nuclear staining. Additional membranous positivity was observed in a few lung cancers. Several thyroid cancers along with a few adenocarcinomas of cervix were strongly stained. Lymphomas, prostate, testicular and renal cancers were generally negative.
Most cancer cells showed weak to moderate staining. Gliomas, melanomas, testis, urothelial, renal and hepatocellular carcinomas were negative. Cancer stroma was often distinctly stained.
Strong cytoplasmic and nuclear immunoreactivity was observed in lymphomas  and cases of melanomas and breast cancers. Remaining cancers were in general negative.
Cancer tissues exhibited moderate to strong cytoplasmic and nuclear immunoreactivity. Strong membranous staining was observed in several adenocarcinomas.
Moderate to strong cytoplasmic, extracellular positivity was seen in most malignancies. Tumor stroma were strongly positive.

Most malignant tissues were negative. Malignant gliomas and rare cases of breast cancers and malignant melanomas displayed distinct positivity in a fraction of the cells, often with a dot-like pattern or accentuated towards the nuclear membranes.
Most cancer tissues displayed moderate to strong cytoplasmic immunoreactivity. Strongest staining was observed in colorectal cancers.

Cases of lymphomas showed strong nuclear positivity. A majority of melanomas, carcinoids, renal, pancreatic, thyroid and endometrial cancers displayed weak to moderate cytoplasmic immunoreactivity. Most of the remaining cancers were negative.
A majority of renal cancers were moderately stained. Most remaining cancer tissues were weakly stained or negative.
Several cases of most cancers showed moderate to strong cytoplasmic and membranous positivity.
Several cases of breast, renal, pancreatic and urothelial cancers showed moderate cytoplasmic staining. Remaining cancers generally showed weak staining or were negative.
Malignant cells were generally negative. Malignant melanomas and liver cancers along with a few malignant gliomas and pancreatic cancers displayed moderate cytoplasmic positivity.
Cancer cells were generally negative. Lymphomas and a few cases of colorectal, breast and prostate cancers were moderately stained.
A majority of malignant cells displayed moderate to strong cytoplasmic immunoreactivity. Several malignant gliomas, renal cancers and liver cancers were weakly stained or negative.
Colorectal cancer showed moderate nuclear positivity. Remaining tissues were generally weak or negative.
Moderate to strong nuclear immunoreactivity was observed in most malignant lymphomas. Remaining malignant cells were generally negative.
